authOptional: Require authentication only for paths marked "Required" below; all other paths are public
rulesHelp: Matched by path prefix, the longest prefix wins. Paths are normalized first (../ and duplicate slashes removed) before matching
countryCodesPlaceholder: Two-letter ISO codes separated by commas, e.g. CN, HK, US
lanAlwaysAllowed: Private network addresses are always allowed.
geoMissing: No GeoIP database imported yet, so filtering has no effect (import one in "Global settings").
shareHelp: Opening the link once grants a sign-in-free session of up to 24 hours. 0 uses means unlimited; redemption counts reset after a restart; deleting a link immediately invalidates the sessions it issued
